label: Type relay (words from an object, back into one)
description: The WORDS of a relay film: a full-frame type card whose words come FROM an object and turn back INTO one, so the type beat joins the pieces around it on identical frames. 1-3 lines of big display type (Geist 600, tight tracking; an accent substring in the accent colour, optionally Instrument Serif italic), left-aligned at x (default 0.08) or centred, the block vertically centred on y (0.5). Font px per line = min(box w, box h) x {xl 0.15, l 0.10, m 0.068} x scale (first line xl, later lines l by default); line height 1.04 em; a line longer than max_width wraps at words, and everything shrinks only if one word is wider than max_width or the block is taller than 0.9 of the box. REVEAL: words (default: each word rises 0.34 em and comes into focus over 0.55 s, word_stagger apart), lines (each line rises out of its own mask line, 0.6 s), type (a typewriter at type_speed chars/s with an accent caret). Line i starts at its own `at`, else after the line before it (words: + n_words x word_stagger + 0.1 s). FROM (object -> words): at from.at the card draws EXACTLY from.shape in from.color (a feed row, a black pill, a dot, or the whole frame {x:0.5,y:0.5,w:1,h:1,radius:0} after a flood) -- hide the previous piece at the same time; the shape morphs (power3.inOut, from.duration 0.45 s) onto the accent word's box (the text block when there is no accent), then pulls off it to the right over from.wipe (0.28 s), uncovering the accent word, while the other words radiate out of it in order of distance. TO (words -> object) at to.at over to.duration: squeeze (the whole block condenses like an accordion -- letters narrow faster than they shorten, taking to.color -- into a band inside to.shape, then the solid shape springs onto to.shape and ends EXACTLY on that box at to.at + to.duration; the next piece takes over there; default shape the relay pill {x:0.5,y:0.5,w:0.3,h:0.085}), flood (the accent word's box wipes into a solid to.color block -- default the accent colour -- that grows to cover the whole frame by to.at + to.duration; the next scene opens on that colour, e.g. color-flood contract), lift (the lines fly up and out, power3.in), scatter (the words fly apart outward with depth, half toward the camera), hold (nothing). Shapes are {x, y (CENTRE), w, h, radius?} as fractions of the component box (a full-frame slot is the camera layer, 40 px larger than the frame: 1960x1120 for 16:9, so fractions are of that box as with every relay piece); radius is a fraction of the box's shorter side, omitted = fully round. The root publishes the measured geometry (fractions of the box, after the face has landed): data-word-boxes (JSON [{text,cx,cy,w,h}], each word's line box), data-text-box and data-accent-box ("cx,cy,w,h"; the accent box is the accent characters +-0.08 em by the line box -- what `from` lands on and `flood` starts from), data-to-box (the squeeze target), data-font-px, data-settle-time (the reveal's end) and data-end-time (to.at + to.duration). Every style is a pure function of the time: a seek anywhere renders the same frame. Examples: {"lines":[{"text":"Every click, counted.","accent":"counted."},{"text":"Every account, known."}],"from":{"shape":{"x":0.78,"y":0.3,"w":0.3,"h":0.07,"radius":0.012},"color":"#393bf5","at":0},"to":{"mode":"squeeze","at":2,"duration":0.5,"shape":{"x":0.5,"y":0.62,"w":0.1,"h":0.175},"color":"#0b0b0c"}}; {"lines":[{"text":"Then it floods.","accent":"floods.","italic_accent":true}],"align":"center","to":{"mode":"flood","at":2,"duration":0.45}}.

lines.label: 1-3 lines: {text, at? (s, when this line starts), size? xl|l|m (default xl for the first line, l after), accent? (a substring coloured in the accent), italic_accent? (set the accent in Instrument Serif italic)}

reveal.label: words (each word rises into focus, staggered) | lines (each line rises out of its mask) | type (typewriter)

at.label: When the first line starts (s; with `from`, the first line starts when the morph lands)

blur.label: words: the words come into focus as they rise (false: rise only)

align.label: left (the block's left edge at x) | center (centred on x)

x.label: left: the block's left edge; center: its centre (fraction of the box width; default 0.08 / 0.5)

y.label: The block's vertical centre, fraction of the box height

max_width.label: Line width before a line wraps, fraction of the box width (default 1 - 2x left, 0.84 centred)

scale.label: Multiplies every line size (1 = xl at 0.15 of the box's shorter side)

tracking.label: Letter spacing in em (default by size: xl -0.042, l -0.034, m -0.024)

accent.label: Accent colour (the accent substring, the caret, the default flood)

background.label: Card fill (default transparent: it sits over other pieces or a flood colour)

from.label: Object -> words: {shape: {x, y, w, h, radius?} (box fractions, x/y the centre), color (default the accent), at (default `at`), duration (0.45), wipe (0.28)}. Frame at from.at = the shape exactly

to.label: Words -> object: {mode: squeeze|flood|lift|scatter|hold, at (default settle + 1), duration (squeeze 0.5, flood 0.45, lift 0.5, scatter 0.6), shape? (squeeze target, box fractions; default the pill {x:0.5,y:0.5,w:0.3,h:0.085}), color? (squeeze: the ink; flood: the accent), hide_at? (the object vanishes instantly)}

seed.label: Changes the scatter's directions and depths (same seed, same scatter)
